title: Best before or use by: what the dates mean
examples: Can I eat food after the best before date?
What is the difference between use by and best before?
Is it safe to eat food after the use by date?

figure.name: x-compare
figure.verdict: Use by is a safety date; best before is a quality date

explain.say: Imagine finding biscuits at the back of the cupboard with a date from last month. Should you throw them away? Look at the two sides of the board. Food packets use two kinds of dates, and they mean very different things.

draw.text: Best before or use by: what the dates mean

draw.name: x-compare
draw.verdict: Use by is a safety date; best before is a quality date

explain.say: Look at the left side, best before. This date is about quality: how crunchy, tasty and fresh the food is. It's on things like rice, pasta, biscuits, tins and frozen food. After the date, the food is usually still safe, just maybe less tasty. Can you find one in your kitchen?

draw.name: x-compare
draw.verdict: Use by is a safety date; best before is a quality date

explain.say: Now the right side, use by. This one is about safety. It's on foods that go off quickly, like fresh meat, fish and some dairy. Harmful germs can grow without changing how food looks or smells, so after the use by date, don't eat it, even if it seems fine.

draw.name: x-compare
draw.verdict: Use by is a safety date; best before is a quality date

explain.say: So, our old biscuits? They have a best before date, so they're probably safe. Look, sniff and check: if they're soft or smell odd, out they go. Which kind of date do you think fresh milk usually has?

draw.name: x-compare
draw.verdict: Use by is a safety date; best before is a quality date

explain.say: Great detective work! Here's a wow: about a third of all the food produced in the world is lost or wasted, and mixing up these dates is one reason. Knowing the difference saves food and money. Challenge: sort five packets at home into best before and use by!

faq.a: Best before is about quality. The food should taste and feel its best until that date, and is often still safe to eat afterwards if stored properly.
asks: Can I eat food after the best before date?

faq.a: Use by is about safety. It goes on foods that spoil quickly, like fresh meat and fish, and you should not eat them after that date.
asks: Is it safe to eat food after the use by date?

faq.q: Why can't I just smell food to check if it's safe?
faq.a: Some harmful germs grow without changing how food looks or smells, so food past its use by date can seem fine but still make you ill.
asks: Can I trust my nose with old food?

faq.a: Sell by or display until dates are for shop staff to manage their stock. They are not meant to tell shoppers whether food is safe.
asks: What is a display until date?

faq.q: Why does food have dates at all?
faq.a: Dates help people know how long food will stay safe and tasty, so they can store it well and use it in time.

facts: In the UK and EU, use-by dates are about safety and best-before dates are about quality.
The UN Food and Agriculture Organization has estimated that roughly a third of the food produced is lost or wasted.

quiz.say: Which date is about food safety?
quiz.show: Which date is about food safety?
quiz.why: Use by dates go on foods that can become unsafe after that date.

wrong.1: Best before is about quality, not safety.
wrong.2: Display until is a note for shop staff.

quiz.show: A tin of beans is one week past its best before date and the tin is fine. What is most likely?
